text: 8月5日，沪深两市全天成交额合计26596.35亿元。其中，沪市成交额为12087.23亿元；深市成交额为14509.11亿元；创业板成交额为7252.64亿元。
text_en: On August 5, the combined daily turnover of the Shanghai and Shenzhen markets totaled 2,659.635 billion yuan. Among this, Shanghai market turnover was 1,208.723 billion yuan; Shenzhen market turnover was 1,450.911 billion yuan; ChiNext turnover was 725.264 billion yuan.
